title: Iulian the jurist
summary: Raleigh names Iulian the jurist in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Iulian the jurist, who interpreted the edicts presented to Adrian the Emperour. Not Julian the Apostate. The one-word title would fold onto julian, so the title is three words. The lex Iulia and the lex Cornelia were not made people. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
